joints.name: A10_JOINT_AILERON_L
joints.actuator: rotary EMA inside the wing on the hinge line + torque tube, irreversible, mass-balanced surface
joints.interlock: neutral and locked whenever the wing is not fully deployed and pinned

joints.name: A10_JOINT_AILERON_R
joints.actuator: rotary EMA inside the wing on the hinge line + torque tube, irreversible, mass-balanced surface

joints.name: A10_JOINT_CANARD_L_FOLD
joints.actuator: fold rotary EMA + shoot-bolt lock; fold pin bearings 0.20 m apart
joints.note: +90 deg (R) / -90 deg (L) = stowed over the front fender

joints.name: A10_JOINT_CANARD_L_PITCH
joints.actuator: rotary EMA on fold yoke, irreversible
